source.text: ወኮነ፡ እምድኅረዝ፡ ከመ፡ ተከብተ፡ መንፈስየ፡ ወ⟦?⟧፡ ውስተ፡ ሰማያት፡ ወርኢክዎሙ፡ ለውሉደ፡ መላእክት፡ ቅዱሳን፡ ይኬይዱ፡ ዲበ፡ ነበልባለ፡ እሳት፡ ወአልባሲሆሙ፡ ፀዓዳ፡ [ወ⟦?⟧፡] ወብርሃነ፡ ገጾሙ፡ ከመ፡ በረድ።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Whole wording held.

translation.text: After this my spirit was taken away and [uncertain transport verb] into the heavens. I saw the children of the holy angels walking on flames of fire. Their garments were white, [uncertain bracketed word], and the brightness of their faces was like ice.[a]

footnotes.text: Actual primary849 supports the taken-away form, but the following transport verb and bracketed token are not confidently transcribed. Literal⟦?⟧ spans in the internal source are POB-added uncertainty markers, not Charles marks or claims of lost ancient words. Actual507–508 gives ice as well as hail in the brightness comparison. The source says children of holy angels, not an inserted sons-of-God formula. Whole wording held.

source.text: ወርኢኩ፡ ክልኤተ፡ አፍላገ፡ እሳት፡ *ወብርሃነ፡ ዝኩ፡ እሳት፡ ከመ፡ ያኅንት፡ ያበርህ፡ ወወደቅኩ፡ በገጽየ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚአ፡ መናፍስት።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Author acceptance only, requiring distinct exact-payload independent assessment.

translation.text: I saw two rivers of fire, and the light of that fire shone like yaḥent. I fell on my face before the Lord of Spirits.[a]

footnotes.text: The actual selected source has two rivers, not one or an apparatus numeral. Yaḥent is a held-to-source transliteration of the selected gem expression, not the plant hyacinth or a modern mineral identification. Actual primary1073 gives the corresponding traditional precious-stone name and cites71:2;499–500 supports shining. The narrator falls before the Lord of Spirits.

source.text: ወ*መልአኩ፡ ሚካኤል፡ [እምርእሰ፡ መላእክት፡] አኀዘኒ፡ እድየ፡ ዘየማን፡ ወአንሥአኒ፡ ወአውጽአኒ፡ ኀበ፡ ኵሉ፡ *ኅቡአት፡ ወአርአየኒ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኅቡአተ፡ ምሕረት፡ ወ*አርአየኒ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኅቡአተ፡ ጽድቅ።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Whole wording held.

translation.text: The angel Michael, [from the head of the angels], took my right hand, raised me and brought me out to all the hidden things. He showed me all the hidden things of mercy, and he showed me all the hidden things of righteousness.[a]

footnotes.text: The actual source brackets from the head of the angels as an explanatory gloss and retains two hidden-things lines, mercy and righteousness. Neither line is clipped. The bracket relation remains unresolved here; no unprinted one of or later angel hierarchy is inserted. The right hand and first-person recipient remain. Whole wording held.

source.text: ወአርአየኒ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኅቡአተ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወኵሎ፡ መዛግብተ፡ ኮከባት፡ ወብርሃናት፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እምኀበ፡ ወፅኡ፡ ለገጸ፡ ቅዱሳን።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Author acceptance only, requiring distinct exact-payload independent assessment.

translation.text: He showed me all the hidden things of the ends of heaven, and all the storehouses of the stars and lights, from where they all go out before the holy ones.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected final holy ones is plural. It is not changed to a singular Holy One for fluency. All storehouses and both stars/lights are included. Source hidden-things vocabulary is controlled by actual primary600–601, not by a later English Enoch rendering.

source.text: ወከብተ፡ መንፈስየ፡ [ወሄኖክ፡] ውስተ፡ ሰማየ፡ ሰማያት፡ ወርኢኩ፡ በህየ፡ [ማእከለ፡ ዝኩ፡ ብርሃን፡] ከመ፡ ቤት፡ ዘይትነደቅ፡ እምእብነ፡ አስሐትያ፡ ወ*ማእከሊሆሙ፡ ለእማንቱ፡ አባን፡ ልሳናተ፡ እሳት፡ ሕያው።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Whole wording held.

translation.text: My spirit [and Enoch] was taken into the heaven of heavens. I saw there, [in the midst of that light], something like a house built of crystal stone. Among those stones were tongues of living fire.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected edition explicitly brackets and Enoch and in the midst of that light as glosses; their words are retained rather than silently removed. Actual primary331 includes the crystal sense for this frozen-water noun and cites71:5; stone is explicit here, unlike the weather list at69:23. Primary38 controls tongues,127 living and680 being built. The gloss/subject treatment remains held; crystal does not certify the entire verse.

source.text: ወርኢየት፡ መንፈስየ፡ አወደ፡ ዘአወደ፡ ለውእቱ፡ ቤት፡ እሳት፡ ወእምአርባዕቱ፡ አጽናፊሁ፡ ለውእቱ፡ አፍላገ፡ ምሉአን፡ እሳት፡ ሕያው፡ ወአወድዎ፡ ለውእቱ፡ ቤት።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Whole wording held.

translation.text: My spirit saw the circuit that encircled that house of fire. From its four sides were rivers full of living fire, and they surrounded the house.[a]

footnotes.text: Actual primary999–1000 controls encircling and circuit vocabulary. Native detail collation corrected preliminary y-shaped miscopies to the selected d-root forms. That lexical control does not by itself resolve the exact four-sides/rivers attachment. Four, living fire and the full final surrounding clause are retained. Whole wording held.

source.text: ወአወዱ፡ ሱራፌን፡ ወ*ኪሩቤን፡ ወ*ኦፋኔን፡ ወእሉ፡ አማንቱ፡ እለ፡ ኢይነውሙ፡ ወየዐቅቡ፡ መንበረ፡ *ስብሐት፡ ዚአሁ።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Author acceptance only, requiring distinct exact-payload independent assessment.

translation.text: Seraphim, cherubim and ophanim surrounded it. These are the ones who do not sleep and who guard his throne of glory.[a]

footnotes.text: Actual primary349 gives the seraphim order,837 cherubim and808 ophanim with71:7. These familiar English order names represent the selected Ethiopic forms, not a borrowed English translation. Their source stars remain internal. The selected negative is do not sleep, and the guarded object is his throne of glory; no unprinted divine personal name is supplied.

source.text: ወርኢኩ፡ መላእክተ፡ እለ፡ ኢይትኀለቁ፡ አእላፈ፡ አእላፍ፡ ወትእልፊተ፡ ትእልፊት፡ የአውድዎ፡ ለውእቱ፡ ቤት፡ ወሚካኤል፡ ወሩፋኤል፡ ወገብርኤል፡ ወፋኑኤል፡ ወመላእክት፡ ቅዱሳን፡ እለ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሰማያት፡ ይበውኡ፡ ወይወፅኡ፡ ለውእቱ፡ ቤት።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Author acceptance only, requiring distinct exact-payload independent assessment.

translation.text: I saw angels beyond counting, thousands upon thousands and myriads upon myriads, surrounding that house. Michael, Rufael, Gabriel and Fanuel, and the holy angels above the heavens, went into and out of that house.[a]

footnotes.text: The source retains two large-number series rather than replacing them with only countless. Actual primary721 allows indefinite thousands and the myriad class and explicitly cites71:8; no computed exact population is claimed. Actual576–577 controls not being counted. The four selected names are retained as Michael, Rufael, Gabriel and Fanuel, without harmonizing the latter two nonstandard English spellings to another chapter. Going in and out both remain.

source.text: ወወፅኡ፡ እምነ፡ ውእቱ፡ ቤት፡ ወሚካኤል፡ ወሩፋኤል፡ ወገብርኤል፡ ወፋኑኤል፡ ወብዙኃን፡ ቅዱሳን፡ መላእክት፡ እለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ኁልቈ።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Author acceptance only, requiring distinct exact-payload independent assessment.

translation.text: Michael, Rufael, Gabriel and Fanuel came out of that house, with many holy angels beyond number.[a]

footnotes.text: All four selected names and the many unnumbered holy angels remain. This unit begins a fresh explicit9 on PDF168; it is not an unreviewed continuation of8. The count and names are read from the actual selected photograph, not copied from a familiar English angel list.

source.text: ወምስሌሆሙ፡ ርእሰ፡ መዋዕል፡ ወርእሱ፡ ኮነ፡ ከመ፡ ፀምር፡ ፀዓዳ፡ ወጽሩይ፡ ወልባሱ፡ ዘኢይትርጐም።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Author acceptance only, requiring distinct exact-payload independent assessment.

translation.text: With them was the Head of Days. His head was like white, pure wool, and his clothing was indescribable.[a]

footnotes.text: Head of Days follows the selected title, not a silently substituted Ancient of Days. Actual primary925–926 controls the days title. Native detail collation restored the source was verb and corrected a first-pass miscopy of the final verb; actual primary556–557 explicitly cites71:10 under inenarrabilis, supporting indescribable clothing. White and pure both remain in the wool comparison.

source.text: ወወደቅኩ፡ በገጽየ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ሥጋየ፡ ተመስወ፡ ወመንፈስየ፡ ተወለጠ፡ ወጨራኅኩ፡ በቃል፡ ዐቢይ፡ ... በመንፈሰ፡ ኀይል፡ ወባረኩ፡ ወሰባሕኩ፡ ወአልዓልኩ።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Whole wording held.

translation.text: I fell on my face. All my flesh melted, and my spirit was changed. I cried out with a loud voice … with a spirit of power, and I blessed, praised and exalted.[a]

footnotes.text: Actual primary180 explicitly cites71:11 for melting or dissolving, and889–890 supports the spirit being changed. The actual three printed dots are retained as an ellipsis without an invented phrase; the primary apparatus reports something lost. A separate critical-treatment judgment would be needed before publication. Whole wording held.

source.text: ወእልኩ፡ በረከት፡ እለ፡ ወፅአ፡ እምነ፡ አፉየ፡ ከመ፡ ሠመራት፡ ቅድመ፡ ዝኩ፡ ርእሰ፡ መዋዕል።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Author acceptance only, requiring distinct exact-payload independent assessment.

translation.text: The blessings that came out of my mouth were pleasing before that Head of Days.[a]

footnotes.text: Actual primary235 gives the accepted or pleasing participial range and cites71:12;505–506 controls blessing. The selected blessings come from the narrator’s mouth and stand as pleasing before the Head of Days. No new content for the blessings is supplied across the preceding printed dots.

source.text: ወመጽአ፡ ውእቱ፡ ርእሰ፡ መዋዕል፡ ምስለ፡ ሚካኤል፡ ወሩፋኤል፡ ወገብርኤል፡ ወፋኑኤል፡ አእላፍ፡ ወትእልፊተ፡ መላእክት፡ እለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ኁልቈ።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Author acceptance only, requiring distinct exact-payload independent assessment.

translation.text: That Head of Days came with Michael, Rufael, Gabriel and Fanuel, with thousands and myriads of angels beyond number.[a]

footnotes.text: The four selected names remain in their actual order. Actual primary721 controls the two large-number classes. The source has thousands/myriads of angels without a number; no arithmetical total or a new angel category is invented.

source.text: ወመጽአ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ውእቱ፡ መልአክ፡ አምኀ፡ ወይቤለኒ፡ አንተ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወልደ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘተወለድከ፡ ለጽድቅ፡ ወጽድቅ፡ ላዕሌከ፡ ነበረ፡ ወጽድቁ፡ ለርእሰ፡ መዋዕል፡ ኢይኀድገከ።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Author acceptance only, requiring distinct exact-payload independent assessment.

translation.text: That angel came to me, greeted me and said to me, “You are the Son of Man, born for righteousness. Righteousness has rested upon you, and the righteousness of the Head of Days will not leave you.”[a]

footnotes.text: The selected address is second-person singular: You are the Son of Man, born for righteousness. It is not silently changed to This is the Son of Man or assigned to another speaker to harmonize theology. Actual primary734 supports the greeting verb, visibly collated as amha rather than the first-pass from reading. The righteousness of the Head of Days will not leave you preserves the negative and singular addressee. This is a selected-edition reading, not a fresh manuscript claim or a later personal identification.

source.text: ወይቤለኒ፡ *ይጼውዕ፡ ለከ፡ ሰላም፡ በስመ፡ ለዓለም፡ ዘይከውን፡ እስመ፡ እምህየ፡ ወፅአ፡ ሰላም፡ እምፍጥረተ፡ ዓለም፡ ወከመዝ፡ ይከውን፡ ለከ፡ ለዓለም፡ ወለዓለመ፡ ዓለም።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Whole wording held.

translation.text: He said to me, “[Unresolved peace-calling clause], in the name of the age to come; for peace came forth from there, from the creation of the world. So it will be for you forever and ever.”[a]

footnotes.text: Actual primary1301 supports calling but does not make the selected calls-for-you-peace construction an ordinary greeting with resolved tense and subject. The primary editorial comparison is not adopted into source or English. The rest of the creation/peace and singular-for-you duration clauses remain, but the whole wording is held.

source.text: ወኵሉ፡ ይሖሩ፡ ዲበ፡ ፍኖትከ፡ እንዘ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ኢይኀድገከ፡ ለዓለም፡ ምስሌከ፡ ይከውን፡ መኅደሪሆሙ፡ ወምስሌከ፡ ክፍሎሙ፡ ወእምኔከ፡ ኢይትሌለዩ፡ ለዓለም፡ *ወለዓለመ፡ ዓለም።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Author acceptance only, requiring distinct exact-payload independent assessment.

translation.text: All will walk on your path, while righteousness will never leave you. Their dwelling will be with you, and their portion with you. They will never be separated from you, forever and ever.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected singular you/your address is retained throughout, with plural their dwellings/portion and they will not be separated. Native collation restored the final separate verb; actual primary60 explicitly cites71:16 under separation. Righteousness does not leave you, not an invented failure by the addressee. No third-person harmonization to match17 is made.

source.text: ወከመዝ፡ ይከውን፡ ኑኅ፡ መዋዕል፡ ምስለ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወልደ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ወሰላም፡ ይከውን፡ ለጻድቃን፡ ወ*ፍኖተ፡ ርትዕ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ በስመ፡ እግዚአ፡ መናፍስት፡ ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም።
source.note: Actual complete selected native photographs166–169 and170boundary control inspected; selected signs retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation normalized. Author acceptance only, requiring distinct exact-payload independent assessment.

translation.text: So there will be length of days with that Son of Man. There will be peace for the righteous, and an upright path for the righteous, in the name of the Lord of Spirits forever and ever.[a]

footnotes.text: Actual primary673–674 explicitly cites71:17 for length of days. The source now says with that Son of Man in the third person; it is not silently rewritten to with you to harmonize the preceding address. The final path expression has awkward nominal syntax noted by the primary editor; the English gives its upright-path sense under the shared there-will-be clause without inventing a new path owner. Peace, the righteous and the Lord of Spirits name/duration remain.
